note: The two United Kingdom records whose living costs are published in a shape no general rule can read: Glasgow as a monthly range on a student-life page, Birmingham as weekly essential and variable scenarios.

note.en: Glasgow publishes GBP 1,100 to 1,700 a month to live and study in the city, updated August 2026; 1,400 is the midpoint. The university builds the range from the UCAS budget calculator rather than from its own survey of student spending, so it is a planning range and not an observed average. The separate GBP 31,958 figure on this record is Glasgow's maximum borrowing budget for United States federal loan applicants and includes visa fees, the immigration health surcharge and two flights home, so it is not a living cost.
note.tr: Glasgow, sehirde yasamak ve okumak icin ayda 1.100-1.700 GBP yayimlar; Agustos 2026'da guncellenmistir ve 1.400 orta noktadir. Universite bu araligi kendi ogrenci harcama arastirmasindan degil UCAS butce hesaplayicisindan kurar, bu yuzden gozlemlenen bir ortalama degil bir planlama araligidir. Bu kayittaki ayri 31.958 GBP rakami, Glasgow'un Amerika Birlesik Devletleri federal kredi basvuru sahipleri icin azami borclanma butcesidir ve vize ucretlerini, gocmenlik saglik ek ucretini ve iki ucus biletini icerir; bu yuzden bir yasam gideri degildir.

sources.title: University of Glasgow: Cost of living

note.en: Birmingham's postgraduate money advice publishes weekly scenarios rather than a single budget: GBP 185 a week of essential costs in self-catered halls, GBP 174 a week in a private house, and GBP 110 a week of variable costs on top of either. The halls scenario is used here, so GBP 295 a week over a 52-week year. Accommodation fees run from GBP 5,335 to GBP 17,966 across 17 published postgraduate room options, with utilities, Wi-Fi and contents insurance included, so a student choosing an expensive room should expect to exceed this figure.
note.tr: Birmingham'in lisansustu para danismanligi tek bir butce yerine haftalik senaryolar yayimlar: kendi yemegini yapan yurtlarda haftada 185 GBP zorunlu gider, ozel bir evde haftada 174 GBP ve her ikisinin ustune haftada 110 GBP degisken gider. Burada yurt senaryosu kullanilir, yani 52 haftalik bir yil boyunca haftada 295 GBP. Konaklama ucretleri, faturalar, Wi-Fi ve esya sigortasi dahil olmak uzere yayimlanan 17 lisansustu oda secenegi arasinda 5.335 ile 17.966 GBP arasinda degisir; bu yuzden pahali bir oda secen bir ogrenci bu rakami asmayi beklemelidir.

sources.title: University of Birmingham: Postgraduate money advice
